court: In the High Court of Madras
respondents: Tamil Nadu Civil Supplies Corporation, rep. By its General Manager (ADM) and Another .…. Respondents.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

S. Vaidyanathan, J.:— When the matter is taken up for hearing today, learned counsel for the Petitioner sought permission of this Court to withdraw the Writ Petition and he has also made an endorsement in the case bundle to the following effect:

“The Writ Petition be dismissed as withdrawn.”

2. In view of the above, this Writ Petition is dismissed as withdrawn. No costs.
